article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-leaning hybrid
Genetics: NYC Diesel × Jokerz #31
Breeder: Compound Genetics
THC Content: 26%
CBD Content: Typically low
Terpene Profile: limonene , beta-caryophyllene
Primary Flavors: Grapefruit, diesel fuel, sweet gas, citrus
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: late September / early October
Indoor Yield: High
Outdoor Yield: High
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

NYC Vapor takes one of the most recognizable aromas in old-school cannabis —the sharp grapefruit-and-fuel character of NYC Diesel—and pushes it through the dense resin, candy gas, and modern potency of Jokerz #31. The result is less like a softened reinterpretation of Diesel and more like two eras of marijuana breeding colliding in the same flower. Crack apart a mature bud and bright citrus can rise immediately, followed by petroleum, sweet gas, floral perfume, and a lingering candy quality that becomes more obvious after curing. Compound Genetics specifically built the cross around the grapefruit-heavy NYC Diesel cut selected by Soma Seeds , giving this cultivar a far more distinctive aromatic direction than many contemporary hybrids.

The plant carries similarly mixed traits. Medium-to-high stretch gives it more vertical energy than a compact dessert strain, yet the flowers develop with the density, frost, and visual polish expected from the Jokerz family. Compound Genetics lists an approximately eight-week flowering period, high yield potential, and exceptionally heavy trichome production, making NYC Vapor attractive for both premium flower and resin-focused cultivation. Its combination of classic Diesel sharpness and modern purple-candy genetics gives this weed strain a recognizable identity without abandoning either side of the cross.
Genetics and Lineage

NYC Vapor is a direct cross of NYC Diesel and Jokerz #31. The NYC Diesel parent used by Compound Genetics is a cut hunted by Soma Seeds and selected for its unusually powerful grapefruit aroma. That selection carries the citrus-fuel personality responsible for much of the offspring’s immediately recognizable nose. NYC Diesel became an important cultivar because it paired the sour petroleum qualities associated with Diesel cannabis with a much brighter fruit component, producing flowers that could smell simultaneously like grapefruit rind, fermented citrus, and fuel.

Jokerz #31 represents the modern half of the pedigree. Compound Genetics created Jokerz from White Runtz × Jet Fuel Gelato , then selected phenotype #31 from a population of roughly 180 plants. The keeper was chosen for exceptional flower quality, structure, color, trichome development, aroma, and smoothness after drying and curing. Jokerz #31 typically expresses floral perfume, candy, Gelato-like sweetness, and gas, with purple flowers coated heavily in resin. Its own terpene profile is commonly dominated by limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and myrcene, while THC levels in the parent cut frequently reach the upper-20% range.

Bringing these two lines together gives NYC Vapor a wider aromatic spectrum than either parent alone. Grapefruit and Diesel remain central, but Jokerz adds sweetness, floral character, additional fuel, and substantial resin production. Structurally, the cross also benefits from the vigor and stretch of NYC Diesel while gaining the heavier flower density and visual finish associated with Jokerz #31. That combination explains why the cultivar can feel simultaneously old-school and contemporary: the scent recalls classic New York Diesel-era weed, while the flowers look and finish more like modern boutique cannabis .
Effects and Experience

NYC Vapor generally begins with a noticeable cerebral rise. The first portion of the experience can feel mentally bright, socially engaging, and somewhat expansive, with conversation, music, food, or creative activity becoming more interesting. The Diesel side helps keep the onset from feeling immediately heavy, while the Jokerz influence adds enough potency to make the change in headspace apparent even at moderate servings. Rather than producing a frantic burst of stimulation, the effect tends to feel energetic in a controlled, pleasantly euphoric way.

As the session develops, the tone becomes more grounded. Physical relaxation begins spreading through the body while the initial mental brightness gradually softens, creating a balanced middle phase that can work well for evenings when complete sedation is not yet desirable. At moderate doses, many consumers may still feel capable of socializing, watching a movie, cooking, or working on something creative. Larger servings bring the Jokerz side forward more strongly, increasing body weight, mental haziness, and the desire to settle into a comfortable environment.

Potency can vary because NYC Vapor is a seed line rather than a single laboratory-standardized clone. Consumers accustomed to lighter marijuana should therefore approach strong examples cautiously, especially when the flowers display the heavy resin coverage associated with this cross. Dry mouth and dry eyes are common possibilities, while excessive consumption can produce dizziness, temporary anxiety, or a foggy, overly heavy finish. A smaller amount better preserves the strain’s distinctive progression from citrus-bright cerebral energy into deeper physical calm.
Medical Benefits

The shift from uplift to relaxation may give NYC Vapor broad appeal among medical cannabis consumers who prefer a cultivar that does not begin with immediate sedation. During the earlier phase, elevated mood and mental engagement may make everyday stress, low motivation, or emotional fatigue feel less prominent. As the body component develops, muscular tension and general physical discomfort may become easier to ignore without necessarily eliminating all mental clarity at once.

Higher doses change the character considerably. The body becomes more settled, appetite may increase, and the later portion of the experience can become noticeably restful. For that reason, some medical marijuana consumers may prefer the cultivar in late afternoon or evening rather than early in the day. The same potency that creates substantial relaxation can also impair concentration, coordination, and short-term memory, particularly among people with limited THC tolerance.

Individual chemical profiles should matter more than the strain name alone. NYC Vapor does not have one universal terpene or cannabinoid panel, and different phenotypes can emphasize grapefruit, gas, floral sweetness, or heavier resinous characteristics to different degrees. Consumers using cannabis for medical purposes should pay attention to actual laboratory results when available, especially cannabinoid strength and dominant terpenes, while also considering medications, personal THC sensitivity, and dosage.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Grapefruit is the aromatic signature that separates NYC Vapor from the enormous number of sweet-gas hybrids on the modern market. The citrus note is not simply generic lemon; it has the bitter, slightly sharp quality of grapefruit peel, giving the flower a brighter and more distinctive top note. Underneath sits the unmistakable smell of Diesel—fuel, petroleum, and a faintly sour edge that gives the bouquet considerably more depth.

Jokerz #31 adds another layer once the flower is broken apart. Sweet gas, perfume, mild candy, and creamy floral notes can mix with the citrus, creating a profile that moves between fruit and industrial fuel rather than settling cleanly into either category. Phenotypes leaning toward NYC Diesel may emphasize grapefruit and sour fuel, while plants showing stronger Jokerz influence can become sweeter, darker, and more perfume-like.

The flavor closely follows the aroma. Grapefruit and citrus peel often arrive early on the inhale before diesel fuel and sweet gas build through the finish. Lower-temperature vaporization can preserve more of the volatile fruit and floral notes, while combustion tends to emphasize fuel, earth, and resin. A slow, controlled cure is especially valuable because the bright grapefruit character can become muted when flower is dried too aggressively.
Growing Information

Compound Genetics describes NYC Vapor as having medium-to-high stretch, high yield potential, and exceptionally dense trichome coverage. Those traits make canopy planning important from the beginning. Plants allowed to become too tall during vegetative growth can gain substantial height after the flowering cycle begins, so topping, low-stress training , or a trellis can help distribute the stretch laterally. Wider branch spacing also improves light penetration and prevents the vigorous upper canopy from shading productive lower sites.

Indoor flowering takes approximately eight weeks, or around 56 days. During that relatively short period, flowers can develop a heavy resin layer and considerable density, giving the strain strong visual appeal by harvest. High trichome production also increases its usefulness for dry sift, rosin, and ice-water hash. As the buds become heavier, branch support may be useful, particularly on high-yielding phenotypes. Good airflow and controlled late-flower humidity remain essential because large, resinous buds can trap moisture within the canopy.

Outdoor plants need enough seasonal warmth to complete their flowering cycle after natural bloom begins. In many suitable Northern Hemisphere gardens, that places harvest from late September into early October, although latitude and local climate can shift the schedule. Full sun, generous root space, and a long vegetative period can turn the cultivar into a substantial producer. Growers hunting through multiple plants should pay particular attention to grapefruit intensity, resin density, stretch, and flower structure, since the best keeper may not simply be the individual with the largest harvest.
FAQ
What strains make NYC Vapor?

NYC Vapor is a Compound Genetics cross of NYC Diesel × Jokerz #31. The NYC Diesel cut used for the project was selected by Soma Seeds for its intense grapefruit aroma, while Jokerz #31 comes from White Runtz × Jet Fuel Gelato.
Is NYC Vapor indica or sativa?

NYC Vapor is generally considered an indica-leaning hybrid, although its medium-to-high stretch and brighter early effects reflect considerable influence from the NYC Diesel side. The experience commonly begins more cerebral before becoming increasingly relaxing.
What does NYC Vapor taste like?

The defining flavors are grapefruit, diesel fuel, sweet gas, citrus peel, and floral candy. Some plants lean heavily toward sharp grapefruit and sour fuel, while others show more sweetness and perfume from Jokerz #31.
How long does NYC Vapor take to flower?

Compound Genetics lists an indoor flowering time of approximately eight weeks. Outdoor harvest generally falls around late September to early October in climates where flowering begins on a typical Northern Hemisphere schedule.
Is NYC Vapor a high-yielding strain?

Yes. High yield is one of the breeder-listed characteristics of NYC Vapor. The plants also show medium-to-high stretch and very strong trichome production, making canopy management and branch support useful when trying to maximize production.
Final Thoughts on NYC Vapor

NYC Vapor succeeds by preserving the quality that made its NYC Diesel parent memorable rather than burying it beneath modern genetics. Grapefruit remains unmistakable, backed by sour fuel and petroleum before the sweeter candy-gas character of Jokerz #31 begins to emerge. The resulting aroma has enough contrast to stand apart from more uniform dessert hybrids .

Its growth pattern is equally useful. An eight-week flowering cycle keeps production relatively fast, while medium-to-high stretch and strong yields give experienced growers room to build a productive canopy. Heavy trichome coverage adds visual quality and makes the cultivar especially interesting for hash and solventless extraction .

The experience mirrors the pedigree by moving between two different styles of cannabis. NYC Diesel contributes a brighter, more cerebral opening, while Jokerz gradually introduces deeper physical relaxation and greater weight. Moderate servings can remain social and engaging; stronger doses reveal a much calmer, heavier side.

For growers and consumers who miss the sharp grapefruit-fuel identity of classic Diesel marijuana but still want the frost, density, potency, and visual quality associated with current boutique weed, NYC Vapor bridges those worlds particularly well. It is a modern Compound Genetics hybrid whose strongest feature is not novelty for its own sake, but the way it gives a familiar old-school terpene profile an entirely contemporary finish.
